page.content:
Soft-spoken pegasus who speaks to animals and bears Kindness.

How Fluttershy connects

  • Faction: Mane Six — Fluttershy is the kindness-bearing pegasus of the Mane Six.
  • Character: Discord — Fluttershy's friendship is what keeps Discord from remaking Equestria.

What is Fluttershy?

Fluttershy is the pegasus who lives in a lakeside cottage, stares down dragons when she must, and holds the Element of Kindness in the Mane Six.

Key threads lead to Mane Six and Discord.
